institution: Max Planck Schools (Heidelberg University and University of Göttingen)

app_fee.quote: There is no fee to submit your application!

fee_waiver.value: There is no fee to waive.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no fee to submit your application!

gre_general.value: The school's pages do not mention the GRE.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 minimum (or IELTS 6.5); scores no older than four years at application, and the result may be submitted as late as July 15 of the start year.
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL internetbased (IBT) - minimum 90 out of 120 points

also.quote: Please submit the results of a valid English test no later than July 15th of the year in which your program begins

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic (in person or online) minimum band score 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS - In person or online; minimum band score of 6.5

english_waiver.value: No English test is needed if your previous program was taught in English, so an English-medium Indian degree qualifies.
english_waiver.quote: Proof of English language proficiency is required for non-native English speakers unless your previous program was taught in English.

also.quote: proof of completion of an English language bachelor program or proof of at least two years of relevant study/stay in an English language program in the three years prior

notes: Applicants with Indian certificates must also submit APS verification, per the school's FAQ.
